lines: Mm... what is it...? It's noisy over in the living room...
It was a few days after the memorial service at Koukawa Village.
I heard voices coming from the direction of the mansion's living room, chatting cheerfully, and out of curiosity, I decided to approach.
Hehehe... To think something like that would happen...
Kagero and Saika... What a strange combination.
The source of the voices from the living room was Kagero and Saika.
It seemed the two had coincidentally visited the mansion at the same time, and while I was busy with other matters, they were chatting to kill time.
The sight of the two of them chatting so warmly looked like old friends who had known each other for years, making me hesitate to interrupt.
Oh...? Master Kotaro, eavesdropping? How bold of you.
Kagero, who had sensed Fuuma's presence, spoke up.
Just as expected from you, Kagero. I thought I was hiding...
If that counts as hiding, then you still have a long way to go, Master Kotaro. Hehe.
Giving up, Fuuma revealed himself before them. Saika widened her eyes in slight surprise.
I was so engrossed in our conversation with Lady Kagero that I failed to sense your presence, Master... I apologize.
Come, please sit here with us, Master Kotaro.
Seeing Saika bow her head apologetically, Fuuma felt a bit guilty and sat down, reflecting on his behavior.
Thanks to the guidance provided to Koukawa Village, Kagero had rapidly closed the distance with the Fuuma family and deepened her bonds with those connected to the house.
Just idle chit-chat. Nothing worth your attention, Master.
Hearing that makes me feel a little lonely, actually.
Lady Saika was only talking about you, Master Kotaro, over and over.
I am one who serves the young master... It is only natural that I think of him often. That is all.
Let us leave it at that.
Saika, her cheeks faintly flushed, lowered her head, while Kagero maintained a composed demeanor, smiling softly.
Oh, that reminds me, the young master has no tea.
I apologize, but may I borrow the kitchen?
And then, unusually flustered, Saika stood up and left the living room.
Fuuma remained seated across from Kagero, scratching his head lightly in a troubled manner, expressing his bewilderment.
For some reason, Kagero moved to Fuuma's side, startling him, and he let out an involuntary squeak.
Immediately after, the gentle fragrance that softly enveloped him made Fuuma's heart pound violently, and his body tensed slightly.
Kotaro, when will you and Saika be married?
As Fuuma panicked further at the unexpected words, Kagero continued to speak, as if toying with him.
Even if it has only been a few days, the affection between the two of you is evident to me.
In this era, there are no family ties or obligations, so people simply marry those they love, right?
Despite such favorable circumstances, why are you so frustratingly... why do you not unite?
W-What is wrong with you all of a sudden...!?
Beneath the tone that seemed merely nosy, Fuuma sensed something leaking out, like a dark delusion,
and his body stiffened further, instinctively taking a defensive stance.
P-Please calm down a bit... Kagero... something is off...?
What exactly is wrong with me?
While Fuuma was still bewildered by the delusions leaking out from within Kagero, the distance between the two was unilaterally closed.
Kagero pressed herself against him, half-forcing him to the ground, and her slender fingers touched the chin of the bewildered man.
A... mystery?! What's so mysterious about it...
His chin was lifted sharply by her pale, thin fingers, and Fuuma looked straight into her eyes, where something black was swirling deep within.
Your face and personality are completely different, yet I feel something in you that is somehow the same as Gennosuke-sama.
Gennosuke and I are the same...?
Perhaps it is the vessel required of a leader... that makes me feel that way...
The vessel of a leader...? I have something like that...
Despite his confusion over the delusions and the sensation of the woman, he did not mind being complimented.
And if I were Saika, I would have made you mine before allowing any other woman near you...
Kagero smiled softly, yet her gaze conveyed a burning flame deep in the depths of her eyes.
(Is she comparing my relationship with Saika to the relationship between Kagero and Gennosuke...?)
If that was the case, Kagero's actions made sense.
(Unlike Kagero, Saika could be with me, yet she refuses to... Is she letting her jealousy boil over...?)
Just as Kagero had compared Fuuma and Gennosuke, Fuuma also felt a certain similarity between Kagero and Saika.
(Saika and Kagero... Even though they are completely different, there is something... somewhere...)
Kotaro-sama... what are you thinking about?
About me and Saika...? Fufu, you feel that we are exactly alike as well, do you not, Kotaro-sama?
As she spoke, the flame of Kagero's jealousy slowly intensified.
Why... with a woman like that...!
Kagero leaned in, closing the distance until she was just a breath away from kissing him, and Fuuma was left at a loss.
Me and Gennosuke-sama... if we are never to be united... then perhaps...
Kagero... what is wrong with you...!? You are acting strange...!
Strange...? From my perspective, it is you and Saika who are the strange ones.
I envy you, I am jealous... you have the possibility of being together, yet...
I tried to calm Kagero, who was surrendering herself to the flames of jealousy, but all my efforts proved futile.
You and Saika... I will snatch Fuuma Kotaro away from her...
I shall ensure that you are never united... forever...
There was a hint of madness in Kagero's smile, driven mad by jealousy, and a chill ran down Fuuma's spine.
Wait a moment...! In this era, a kiss... a kiss alone does not strip a woman of her virtue!
So... let us stop this... okay...? Kagero...
Panicking, Fuuma desperately tried to persuade her to stop.
Fuuma Kotaro: "Fufufu, how amusing you are, Fuuma Kotaro."
Kagero suddenly burst into laughter, and for a moment Fuuma relaxed his guard, but her smile vanished in an instant.
In the world of ninjas, it is the same in our time as well.
No, even sharing one's body with another does not damage the feelings one holds for their true love.
Then what did you mean by 'snatch away' just now...
It means to cut off Fuuma Kotaro's life... forever... so that you can never be united...
Cut off... his life!? What does that have to do with a kiss...!
Since it is you, Fuuma Kotaro... I suppose I may reveal it...
Kagero's lips, under the gaze of a man, opened quietly.
When my emotions rise, my breath carries a lethal poison. Keep this a secret from others.
Though... from now on, you will be forever silent, Fuuma Kotaro...
Carries a poison...? Is that your... ninjutsu, Kagero!?
By the time you realize it, it is already too late... hehe...
Perhaps in that moment, she must have been thinking intensely of Koga Gennosuke.
Kagero's cheeks flushed red, her long, beautiful eyes lost in a daze as her body grew hot and flushed.
And I felt something invisible being exhaled from her lips.
It did not take long before I realized it was the Death Breath Kagero had spoken of.
As the sweet, intoxicating scent of death grew thicker, Kagero's eyes locked straight onto Fuuma.
Haa haa... Now then... Fuuma Kotaro... let us share a kiss of death...
Kagero closed her eyes and brought her lips close to Fuuma's.
Sensing his own death approaching, Fuuma closed his eyes, having given up on everything.
Fuuma Kotaro... are you ready...? Hehe...
(If there had been someone who cared for me, as Kagero says... I wish I had accepted it...)
(But... no matter how much I regret it, it is too late...)
Tormented by regret, I waited with my eyes closed as Kagero's lips touched mine, awaiting the end of my life.
Feeling a strange sensation as Kagero's lips did not quite touch mine, Fuuma cautiously opened his eyes.
The moment their eyes met, she pulled away sharply and returned to her seat across from Fuuma, as if nothing had happened.
That was merely a joke. Please do not take it seriously.
Her expression, filled with a terrifying intensity, was far too serious to be just a joke.
As if to admonish the stunned Fuuma, Kagero continued speaking.
We live in an era free from the bonds that bind us, yet if we were to be so careless as we are now...
...I do not know when we might cease to be "eternally bound"...
The feelings that surfaced at the edge of death... please hold them dear, Lord Kotaro.
Kagero's words made the brutal harshness of the old ninja world painfully clear.
Perhaps the era Kagero lived in and this current age, where humans and demons are mixed together... are the same after all...
Fuuma felt that she had taught him this, even while mixing in threats. Kagero spoke up again.
If... I were to truly take your life, Lord Kotaro... I would surely be avenged.
That would be the same as dying with you... It is not worth the trouble.
If I were to die with someone... it would be with Master Gennosuke...
From the breath escaping Kagero's lips, I sensed the aura of death once more.
(She must be picturing the scene of dying with Gennosuke...)
Over these past few days, Fuuma had experienced both the depth of Kagero's light and the depth of her darkness.
He had felt both of them painfully, with his very body.
